description: This file defines an Express router for handling GET, HEAD, and OPTIONS requests to the /overview endpoint under /api/analytics. It imports middleware for authentication and tenant verification, as well as a controller for fetching overview metrics. The router is mounted under /api/analytics and serves as part of the backend API for analytics dashboard data.

methods.name: GET /overview
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch overview metrics for the dashboard.

methods.name: HEAD /overview
methods.description: Handles HEAD requests to /overview, returning headers with no body for caching purposes.

methods.name: OPTIONS /overview
methods.description: Handles OPTIONS requests to /overview, returning status 204.
